name: Picnic Lantern
story: Pip brings a picnic lantern with its sign in pieces. Build its two shadows so everyone can find the picnic.
objective: Repair three lantern blueprints by matching both silhouettes.
twist: A small shared cube tray makes one cube do useful work in two shadows.
rule: Match both raised silhouettes exactly. Any 3D build that fits is valid; cubes can float and be removed at any time.
controls: Arrows: move across tray. E/Q: raise/lower cursor. Space: add/remove cube. U: undo last edit.
ending: The lantern glows; Pip points the picnic guests toward home.

puzzles.name: The lantern post
puzzles.story: Pip holds up the lantern post. The FRONT panel reads width; the SIDE panel reads depth.
puzzles.payoff: The lantern has a sturdy little foot.

puzzles.name: A sign with depth
puzzles.story: Pip turns the sign sideways: a wide front can also cast a wide side. One cube helps both.
puzzles.payoff: The picnic arrow points the right way.

puzzles.name: A roof for fireflies
puzzles.story: Three fireflies need a tiny roof. Match its bright raised tiles and remove any extra shadow.
puzzles.payoff: The fireflies settle under the lantern roof.
